help.app prepareLocal:
Usage: dohc app prepareLocal '<JSON>' [options]

Prepare an app to open on this computer.

Fields: workspaceId, appRoot
Review the source and the Collection access it asks for, then approve.

Run dohc inside a workspace folder while the dohc app is open.
Each verb takes one JSON object that names workspaceId. Find workspaceId in
.dohc/manifest.json at the workspace root.

Options:
  --as-agent   Post and read chat as an agent.
  --json       Print the result as JSON.
  --help       Show help. -h does the same.
help.app withdraw:
Usage: dohc app withdraw '<JSON>' [options]

Stop a shared publication.

Fields: workspaceId, publicationId, expectedAuthorityRevision
Set publicationId to publications[].publicationId from list.
Set expectedAuthorityRevision to publications[].authorityRevision from list.
For an app approved on this computer, take publicationId and authorityRevision
from listLocal.
withdrawalUnconfirmed means access ended, but responses the app sent earlier are
not yet confirmed saved or refused. Withdraw again with the returned
authorityRevision to confirm.

Run dohc inside a workspace folder while the dohc app is open.
Each verb takes one JSON object that names workspaceId. Find workspaceId in
.dohc/manifest.json at the workspace root.

Options:
  --as-agent   Post and read chat as an agent.
  --json       Print the result as JSON.
  --help       Show help. -h does the same.
help.app revokeCollection:
Usage: dohc app revokeCollection '<JSON>' [options]

Remove a shared publication's Collection access.

Fields: workspaceId, publicationId, expectedAuthorityRevision
Set publicationId to publications[].publicationId from list.
Set expectedAuthorityRevision to publications[].authorityRevision from list.
For an app approved on this computer, this ends its approval, as withdraw does.

Run dohc inside a workspace folder while the dohc app is open.
Each verb takes one JSON object that names workspaceId. Find workspaceId in
.dohc/manifest.json at the workspace root.

Options:
  --as-agent   Post and read chat as an agent.
  --json       Print the result as JSON.
  --help       Show help. -h does the same.
